business.description: Onelife Capital Advisors Limited is a financial advisory company with a strategy guided by technology, funding, and management oversight. It operates a proprietary Super App ecosystem 'Onelifetouch' unifying stock broking, financial services, healthcare, real estate, and e-commerce.

products.note: Unifies stock broking, financial services, healthcare, real estate, and e-commerce into a single sign-in framework with incentive-based partner referral engine

products.note: Revenue from contracts with customers is recognized when the entity satisfies a performance obligation by transferring a promised service to customer

products.name: Brokerage
products.note: Revenue recognized on the date of trade i.e. at a point in time when performance obligations w.r.t. broking services are satisfied. Includes brokerage fees charged on per transaction executed.

products.name: Interest income on loans
products.note: Recorded using the effective interest rate (EIR) method. EIR is the rate that exactly discounts the estimated future cash flows over the expected life of the financial instrument to the gross carrying amount of the financial asset.

outlook.statement: OCAL is moving into the upcoming fiscal cycle with a solid balance sheet and clear operational direction. With the capitalization of Dealmoney Commodities progressing steadily, the company is actively exploring subsequent round corporate funding initiatives to back the rapid scaling of next identified high-growth business segments.

Management is actively tracking corporate data to identify the next stable, cash-generating vertical within the multi-industry portfolio to expand rapidly; exploring subsequent round of corporate funding rounds and institutional capital placement avenues to fund expansion sequentially without impacting existing reserves.
Systematic deployment of rights issue funds into Dealmoney Commodities Private Limited continues.
